name: house-cleaning crucible: adversarial gate over the W5H legs before any merge word

source.anchor: house rule: CRUX before merge - applies to every merged product, house-cleaning included

targets: 1) re-verify every W5H leg acceptance independently or mark UNKNOWN with the exact unobtainable step - none inherited
2) mandate table: every receipt states a HEAD that exists and precedes the receipt write; receipt itself is the leg's closing commit (the NEW mandate) - binary per leg
3) combined-state probe on a scratch tree staging all W5H legs; exact failing surface named if any
4) verdict board + receipt committed on wave5h/crux; receipt is this leg's own closing commit

acceptance.predicate: per-leg verdicts with independent re-execution evidence, UNKNOWNs never laundered
mandate table binary per leg including the receipt-closing-commit check
combined scratch-tree probe recorded, cleaned up

crucible_criteria: carries wave-4 CRX0, wave-5 first-enforcement, and the W5 receipt-commit-gap lessons as standing checks
house rule: unobtainable renders UNKNOWN, never zero and never an estimate
note: Gates all. Merge remains Joe's word.
